newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui takes majority stake in India miner.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui takes majority stake in India miner.

text.p: Mitsui & Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it had acquired a 51 percent stake in Indian iron mining company Sesa Goa Ltd from Ilva Mining, an affiliate of Italian steel maker Ilva SpA.
Sesa Goa, which is the third largest iron mining company in India, produces about 4.5 million tonnes of iron ore per year. The company posted sales of $80 million in 1994/95.
A Mitsui spokesman said the market value of the 10 million Sesa Goa shares that Mitsui had acquired was about 6.0 billion yen.
Mitsui's controlling interest in Sesa Goa is held through Finsider International Co Ltd, a holding company, the spokesman said.
The Japanese trading house now has stakes in iron mining companies in major iron-ore producing countries, namely Australia, Brazil, Canada and India, the spokesman said.
